name: How Might We (HMW)
deliverable: Standardized opportunity statements ready for divergence

steps.text: Explain the three words: How assumes a path exists, Might permits failure, We shares ownership.
Post the validated pain points where everyone can read them before writing begins.
Each person silently drafts two to four questions per pain point, ten words or fewer.
Forbid solutions: rewrite any question that names a feature, screen, or tool.
Post the cards and cluster identical intents without speaking, merging duplicates.
Read one question from each cluster aloud and confirm it carries a usable constraint.

failure: Questions come out so broad they give no grip, or so narrow they hide a chosen feature inside the question.
intervention: Ask what the user is trying to decide at that moment, then rewrite around that decision with one concrete constraint: steps, time, or cost.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in design thinking practice; no single documented originator.
